description: This Java class defines a validator for the OrderType class in the OpenMRS system. It implements validation logic to ensure OrderType instances have valid data, such as unique names, proper hierarchy, and valid concept class associations, for use when saving or updating OrderType objects.

classes.name: OrderTypeValidator
classes.description: A class that implements Spring's Validator interface to validate OrderType objects within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports validation of the provided class type, specifically OrderType.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on an OrderType instance, checking for nulls, duplicates, proper hierarchy, and field lengths, and records any errors encountered.
